time_bounds: Half-open [start_s, end_s); frame timestamps are zero-based frame_id / reported FPS. Container timestamps and event annotations require review before finalization.
sample_method: ceil FPS frame stride so actual nominal timestamps are at least 1 second apart
session_id_semantics: clip_ IDs are file-level grouping IDs, not verified independent filming sessions; captured_at remains unknown
duplicate_policy: Identical faisal-ajao/mohd-faizy video is a single source and calibration only
short_video_policy: shared_carpark is calibration only, full decoded duration 679/24 seconds.

event_boundary_review.method: Full-scene 5-second overview across all clips, 1-second neighboring sequence sheets across previous event-crossing gaps; shared_carpark 0.25-second event crops. All source frames are decoded for integrity separately. Visual sampling is not an independent human continuous-video review.

observations.event: white work-truck arrival and parking maneuver around 10-45s

event_boundary_review.evidence: tmp/stage10_review/*overview* and *boundary*; reproducible sampling recipe in docs/stage10-review.md
event_boundary_review.independent_human_review: pending; do not certify final evaluation event boundaries until other-view ROIs and human event annotation exist.

tail_policy.shared_carpark: Use all 679 decoded frames; end is exclusive 679/24 seconds.
tail_policy.olgarose_lot_1: Exclude t>=145 seconds, including reported/decoded tail discrepancy.

clearance: User reports MIT open-source videos and authorizes project adoption; repository-level declarations are recorded separately in rights_review.json.
test_use: Keep test labels and detector outcomes out of threshold/filter/temporal parameter selection. Sparse test-scene review for split design was performed; do not claim the footage was never viewed.
